newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB, Bankers Trust agree on business tie-up.
newsitem.headline: NCB, Bankers Trust agree on business tie-up.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd said on Thursday that it and Bankers Trust New York Corp had agreed on a business alliance and that NCB would also consider a capital tie-up with the U.S. bank.
The two banks will sign the business tie-up agreement in late April, NCB and Bankers Trust said in a joint statement.
The tie-up is aimed at dealing with Japan's "Big Bang" financial reforms, the statement said.
"We will consider limited capital participation in each other after the ongoing restructuring of NCB's capital is completed," the statement said.
It did not elaborate on the possible equity tie-up.

Under the business alliance, NCB and Bankers Trust will offer financial products to securitise NCB's assets and properties and to boost liquidity, using the Bankers Trust group's brokerage and trust banking functions, the two banks said.
Through the tie-up with Bankers Trust, NCB will be able to maintain services to its customers after its planned withdrawal from overseas business, the two banks said.
NCB plans to offer better services than other Japanese banks helped by Bankers Trust's global network and advanced skills, the statement said.
